article_title: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France

tasks.prompt: What development is at the centre of the article?
options: Education protests spread across France and escalated into violent clashes and disruption
Teachers ended a national strike after winning higher salaries
France closed every secondary school ahead of an election
Police withdrew after students accepted planned budget cuts
tasks.correct_answer: Education protests spread across France and escalated into violent clashes and disruption
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המחאה על תנאי החינוך התרחבה למאות בתי ספר והסלימה לעימותים, הצתות, פציעות ומעצרים.

tasks.prompt: Which school conditions did students initially object to?
options: Short school days and too many teachers
A ban on university applications
Lack of teachers, crowded classrooms and run-down buildings
The removal of all school sports
tasks.correct_answer: Lack of teachers, crowded classrooms and run-down buildings
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התלמידים מחו על מחסור במורים, כיתות צפופות ומבנים מוזנחים, לצד טענות נוספות על שעות וחום.

tasks.prompt: What did the education minister mean when he said the movement had been “hijacked” by non-students?
options: Its websites had been attacked by hackers.
Its direction had been taken over by outsiders.
Its leaders had travelled to another city.
Its demands had been accepted by the government.
tasks.correct_answer: Its direction had been taken over by outsiders.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאן “hijacked” פירושו שהמחאה השתלטה או הוסטה בידי אנשים שאינם תלמידים.

options: A government list of all 1,747 arrests
Pictures of damage at every affected school
Audio of ministers planning education cuts
Two videos showing a police officer being chased and beaten
tasks.correct_answer: Two videos showing a police officer being chased and beaten
tasks.explanation_hebrew: BBC Verify אימת שני סרטונים שבהם נראה שוטר נרדף, נופל ומוכה בראשו.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article quote both ministers and 16-year-old protester Lola?
options: To present conflicting views about whether police action restored order or increased anger
To prove that all protesters supported violence
To show that Lola was speaking for the education ministry
To explain why the presidential election was cancelled
tasks.correct_answer: To present conflicting views about whether police action restored order or increased anger
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השרים מתארים הידרדרות לאלימות, בעוד לולה טוענת שפעולות המשטרה החריפו את הכעס.

tasks.prompt: In this report, what does “deployed” mean in the sentence about tear gas in Strasbourg?
options: Stored for a later investigation
Declared illegal by a court
Used or put into action by police
Thrown at officers by students
tasks.correct_answer: Used or put into action by police
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המשטרה הפעילה או השתמשה בגז מדמיע מחשש שהמצב יהפוך עוין יותר.

tasks.prompt: Give two figures that demonstrate the scale of the unrest.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני נתונים מדויקים, כגון 735 בתי ספר, 1,747 עצורים, 65 אנשי צוות פצועים או נזק של יותר משני מיליון אירו בנאנט.
expected_points: One valid scale figure: 735 of 3,700 schools were affected or 1,747 people were arrested.
A second valid figure: at least 65 staff were injured or one Nantes school suffered over €2m in damage.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how an education protest developed into a wider public-order crisis.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר את דרישות החינוך הראשוניות ואת ההתרחבות לחסימות, הצתות, השלכת חפצים, אלימות ומעצרים.
expected_points: Students began by protesting staffing, overcrowding, buildings, hours and funding.
The movement spread nationwide and included blockades, fires, projectiles, assaults and large-scale arrests.

tasks.prompt: Why might authorities and parents interpret the same protests differently?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את דאגת הרשויות לביטחון ולנזק מול דאגת הורים ותלמידים לתנאי החינוך, זכויות המחאה ואלימות המשטרה.
expected_points: Authorities emphasise violence, weapons, injuries and property damage.
Students and unions emphasise education grievances and protest rights, while parents fear children being caught in escalation.

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced paragraph on whether the protests still served their original educational purpose.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש לפחות בשני פרטים מהכתבה ולהציג גם את התלונות הלגיטימיות וגם את השפעת האלימות או מעורבות גורמים חיצוניים.
expected_points: Mention concrete education complaints such as staffing, overcrowding, buildings or budget cuts.
Explain how violence, arrests and alleged non-student involvement may have shifted attention from those demands.
Reach a reasoned conclusion rather than a one-sided claim.
